items.title: The 2026 Startup Battlefield Top 20: From organs to orbit and everything in between
items.summary: Twenty founders just earned their shot at Disrupt glory. They're headed to the main stage at TechCrunch Disrupt to compete for the $100,000 prize and the coveted Disrupt Cup.
items.creator: Isabelle Johannessen

items.title: Spotify users on iOS 27 can now ask Siri to play music without having to say ‘on Spotify’
items.summary: Siri can now learn users' preferred music app, allowing Spotify listeners to request songs, podcasts, and playlists without specifying which app to use.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Bumble agrees to a $1.3B acquisition deal as online dating faces a reset
items.summary: After years of declining subscriber numbers and falling revenue, Bumble just agreed to a $1.3 billion acquisition.
items.creator: Lauren Forristal
